scope: Custom readout/connection/source/Nested/gate family mapping; parent global metadata crawl and catalog agent cover all per-run records and generic method registries.
limitations: This lane is a semantic catalog, not an exhaustive global run count. One family is not one experiment; variants/seeds/folds/trials are different granularities.
Representative numbers copied from explicit archived reports only; no new training or inference, no live run status verification.
Historical cfg84 80–81% scores and current GCNet mask 79% MOSI scores cannot be merged into a single leaderboard.
Sampler/environment unknown in a source are unknown; do not infer from directory date or nearby run.
A stale launch report can coexist with newer completed artifacts; report existence does not prove run completion.
Some directories contain frozen-only diagnosis and must not count as trained modules. Some implemented controls were not trained.
All performance references here are exploratory per-rate Test-oracle unless explicitly marked validation-selected frozen adapter.
